follow-up time: Duration of the coaching program (13-14 sessions per parent)
exposure: Use of the CO-FIDEL coaching fidelity rating tool
outcome: Changes in coaching fidelity over time
Coach satisfaction with and usefulness of the CO-FIDEL tool
cohort: 4 health coaches delivering an online coaching program to 11 parents of children with suspected developmental delay
finding: The CO-FIDEL tool was found to be feasible for evaluating coaching fidelity, with coaches demonstrating high overall fidelity and some showing significant improvements in coaching skills over time.
